title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in DevItems…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in ShopLentor woolentor-addons up to version 3.5.7. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of a user's browser session.
